source.rationale: The OTHER arm of the window rule: the customer named their own dates (parser carries date_filter_start/end), so the probe passed THOSE bounds through and did NOT inject the 90-day default - and the suffix must not claim a window the probe did not use. The defaulted-arm suffix ('- no recent delivery' since the captain copy decision 2026-08-25: window wording dropped, 'recent' keeps the claim bounded) here would be a lie in both directions: the probe searched June, not any recent window. The short '- no delivery' is honest on a dated turn because the ask itself named the window the claim reads against (conversational scope), and the same goes for the zero-hit close ('matching delivery', pinned in hand-annotate-none-have-delivery's windowed twin). customer_probe_window_days is null - the diagnostic mirror that says the customer's own dates, not the default, scoped this claim. Guards this being 'simplified' into an unconditional windowed suffix, which would break every customer-dated picker turn.
